display.purpose: Release headings in the renderer only. Never in the builder.

title.purpose: Page title in topbar; editor panel section labels.

body.purpose: All body copy in the builder. Compact for production-board density.

body-renderer.purpose: Body copy in announcement templates only. Relaxed for reading comfort.

label.purpose: Table column headers and field section labels. All-caps at 11px only.

shadows.name: ambient-hover
shadows.purpose: Renderer interactive elements at hover only. Lifts to confirm interactivity, disappears on mouse-out. Never used in the builder.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for all state transitions: color, background, shadow. Short and responsive; no choreography.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Builder sidebar and typography scale breakpoint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one violet surface in the builder. Used for the single primary action per screen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-btn-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/></svg>New Release</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #aa3bff; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8b22e0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #aa3bff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #7219c2; } .ds-btn-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary inline action. No background, quiet text. Used for add-bullet, text-link triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #111827; background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #aa3bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Border at rest, violet ring on focus. No border + ring double-treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Q2 AI Workflow Update" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; font-size: 14px; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #aa3bff; }

components.name: Status Badge — Published
components.description: Release lifecycle state badge. Pill shape, tinted semantic background, dot + label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge--published { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge--published .ds-badge-dot { background: #22c55e; } .ds-badge--pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; } .ds-badge--pending .ds-badge-dot { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-badge--approved { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-badge--approved .ds-badge-dot { background: #3b82f6; } .ds-badge--draft { background: #f3f4f6; color: #4b5563; } .ds-badge--draft .ds-badge-dot { background: #9ca3af; } .ds-badge--archived { background: #f3f4f6; color: #6b7280; } .ds-badge--archived .ds-badge-dot { background: #d1d5db; }

components.name: Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Violet tint background + violet-700 text in active state.
components.html: All Releases
components.css: .ds-sidebar-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 16px 12px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: #4b5563; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f3f4f6; color: #111827; } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #ede9fe; color: #6d28d9; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Card / Panel
components.description: Primary container in the builder. White surface on gray-50 ground; 12px radius; 1px border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #374151; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: CTA Button (Renderer)
components.description: The one violet element in a published release announcement. Same accent as the builder's primary button.
components.html: Try it now
components.css: .ds-cta-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 24px; background: #aa3bff; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-cta-btn:hover { background: #8b22e0; } .ds-cta-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #aa3bff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Release Hub is a tool that disappears. PMs open it, do their work, and close it. The interface should never compete for attention with the releases being published — it exists to move content through a workflow, not to be noticed. Surfaces are quiet: off-white backgrounds, gray infrastructure, no decorative flourishes. The only color on screen is color that means something.

The violet accent (#aa3bff) is the one voice that speaks. It appears on action buttons, focus rings, and active nav states — the exact points where a PM is committing to something. The status system extends this logic: amber for pending, blue for approved, green for published. These colors are signals, not decoration. When a PM scans the release table and sees green, they know a release is live. That recognition is the interface doing its job.

The renderer inherits this same system. The violet CTA button in a published release is the same violet as the builder's primary action button. PMs author and their audiences receive in one visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, tonal surfaces: depth through gray-50 vs white, not shadow or blur
Violet reserved for decision points and the active state of things in flight
Status colors are load-bearing: semantic, never decorative
System-ui typography: no personality of its own, maximum legibility
Compact information density; the builder is a production board, not a dashboard

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet appears on at most 10% of any given screen. One primary button. One active nav item. One focus ring at a time. Two violet elements competing on the same screen is prohibited.

rules.name: The Status Purity Rule
rules.body: Amber, blue, and green appear exclusively inside status badges. If you need a callout or highlight block, use a gray-50 tint. Status colors are reserved for workflow state.

rules.name: The Retirement Rule
rules.body: indigo-600 (#4f46e5) and every Tailwind indigo-* value is retired. Violet (#aa3bff) is the canonical accent.

rules.name: The Renderer Exception
rules.body: Body text in the renderer runs at 18px, not 14px. The builder is a production environment; the renderer is a communication surface.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling
rules.body: All-caps text is permitted only at 11px label weight. Never on body copy, never on headings, never on button labels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface has a shadow at rest. Shadows are hover-state feedback only, and only in the renderer. If you are reaching for a box-shadow to add depth to a static card in the builder, use a tonal background shift instead.

dos: Do use violet exclusively as the primary action color: one button, one active nav item, one focus ring per screen.
Do use the tonal shift (gray-50 ground / white surface) as the primary depth signal at rest.
Do use status colors only inside status badges tied to release lifecycle states.
Do use rounded-xl (12px) for panels and cards; rounded-lg (8px) for inputs and buttons; rounded-full for badges.
Do write table column headers and editor section labels in 11px semibold uppercase only.
Do keep the topbar to a title only. It names the view; it does not act.
Do use the renderer's body size (18px) for any surface that is read, not operated.
donts: Don't use indigo-600 (#4f46e5) or any Tailwind indigo value as a primary action color. It is retired.
Don't add shadows to builder cards, panels, or surfaces at rest.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any component.
Don't add a second violet element to a screen to reinforce hierarchy. Competing violet elements collapse the signal.
Don't use status semantic colors (amber, blue, green) outside of status badges.
Don't add glassmorphism, blurred backdrops, or gradient fills.
Don't build a hero-metric panel (big number, supporting stats, gradient accent).
Don't use uppercase text above 11px outside the sidebar wordmark.
